_comment: Optional. Merge into .claude/settings.json to print the loop verdict whenever the review log is edited. Set REVIEW_LOG if the log is not plan/REVIEW.md.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); log="${REVIEW_LOG:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/plan/REVIEW.md}"; case "$f" in *REVIEW.md) python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/skills/adversarial-plan-review/scripts/loop_metrics.py" "$log" --brief ;; esac
